ticker.title: Ticker
ticker.description: Stock ticker of the subject (target) company to filter by, e.g. "AAPL". Leave blank to search across all companies.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Free-text search across the filing (e.g. a company or investor name). Leave blank, along with "ticker", to return all new 13D/13G filings market-wide.

formType.title: Form type
formType.description: 13D signals activist or control intent (the filer may seek to influence management); 13G signals a passive stake (no such intent), typically filed by index funds and institutional holders.

daysBack.title: Days back
daysBack.description: How many days back from today to search, by filing date.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of filings to return, most recently filed first.
